jab.name: Jab
jab.description: A quick, straight punch with your lead hand. Fast and precise.
jab.instruction: Extend your lead arm straight forward, rotating your fist to land with knuckles. Snap it back quickly.

cross.name: Cross
cross.description: A powerful straight punch with your rear hand. Uses body rotation for power.
cross.instruction: Rotate your hips and shoulders as you extend your rear arm straight forward. Full body power.

hook.name: Hook
hook.description: A circular punch thrown with a bent arm, targeting the side of the head or body.
hook.instruction: Bend your elbow 90 degrees, swing horizontally with hip rotation. Lead with your elbow, not your fist.

uppercut.name: Uppercut
uppercut.description: An upward punch aimed at the chin or solar plexus. Great for close range.
uppercut.instruction: Bend your knees, then drive upward with your rear hand, rotating your body. Like a shovel motion.

settings.title: Settings
settings.resetConfirm: Are you sure you want to reset all progress?

tips: Stay hydrated! Drink water before, during, and after your workout.
Warm up properly to prevent injuries. Light cardio and stretching help.
Focus on technique over speed. Good form prevents injuries and builds better habits.
Breathe! Exhale with each punch to maximize power and endurance.
Rest is part of training. Your muscles grow during recovery, not during workouts.
Eat protein within 30 minutes after your workout to help muscle recovery.
Sleep 7-9 hours per night for optimal recovery and performance.
Stretch after your workout to improve flexibility and reduce soreness.
Listen to your body. If something hurts (not just tired muscles), take a break.
Consistency is key. Short, regular workouts are better than occasional long sessions.
